# HubSpot’s Sales Hub pricing guide — essential features for every rep

 Written by: HubSpot Editorial 

 

 Updated: 09/09/26 

HubSpot Sales Hub is a powerful sales acceleration platform that helps teams streamline outreach, close deals faster, and increase revenue. With 84% of customers reporting increased revenue, Sales Hub offers a proven return on investment. This comprehensive Sales Hub pricing guide provides up-to-date pricing and feature comparisons across all Sales Hub plans as of 2026.

The guide breaks down and compares all four tiers of Sales Hub pricing (Free, Starter, Professional, and Enterprise), explains the difference between core seats and sales seats, and calculates real costs for any team size.

### Understanding Seat-Based Pricing

Sales Hub's pricing structure includes two types of seats:

- Sales Seats: Full access to all Sales Hub features at your tier level
- Core Seats: Limited access for team members who need basic CRM functionality

Professional and Enterprise plans allow you to mix seat types. For example, your sales reps might need full sales seats ($90-150/month), while support staff only need core seats ($45-50/month).

### Annual vs Monthly Billing Options

Choosing annual billing saves high costs:

- Starter: Save 40% with annual billing ($9 vs $15 per seat)
- Professional: Save 10% with annual billing ($90 vs $100 per seat)
- Enterprise: No discount (always $150 per seat)

Most teams find annual billing worthwhile, especially when factoring in the one-time onboarding fees for Professional ($1,500) and Enterprise ($3,500) plans.

## Free Sales Tools

Price: $0/month

Users: Up to two

HubSpot‘s free CRM includes essential tools for contact management, pipeline tracking, and basic outreach. The free tier integrates with HubSpot’s Marketing Hub, Service Hub, Content Hub, and Operations Hub. This suite of free tools offers a free business platform. Also, HubSpot's AI tools are included in all Sales Hub paid tiers and the free plan.

This free tier includes HubSpot branding and is ideal for solo users or teams testing CRM solutions.

### Key Features

Contact & Deal Management

- Unlimited contacts and companies
- Basic deal pipeline (1 pipeline only)
- Task and activity tracking
- Email integration with Gmail/Outlook

Sales Tools

- Meeting scheduler with calendar sync
- Email tracking (up to 200 notifications/month)
- 3 email templates
- Basic chatbot functionality
- Mobile app access

### Limitations

The free tier has several restrictions:

- HubSpot branding on all tools
- Only 2 user seats (no additional seats available)
- Limited email tracking notifications
- No automation or sequences
- Basic reporting only
- No phone support

Best for: Individuals and early-stage startups seeking a no-cost CRM with basic sales capabilities.

## Sales Hub Starter Pricing

Price: $9/seat (billed annually)

Deal Tags: 10 deal tags per account for all pipelines

Sales Automation: Trigger tasks and email notifications when deals change stage

Sales Hub Starter removes HubSpot branding and adds powerful features like conversation routing, HubSpot payments, and unlimited email notifications. Starter also unlocks two deal pipelines per account, compared to just one in the Free plan, which enables teams to manage multiple sales processes (e.g., new business vs. renewals) separately. Additionally, users get 500 calling minutes per account per month, supporting outbound outreach directly from the CRM.

Starter further enhances sales productivity with features like task queues, custom properties, and conversation routing, enabling reps to organize follow-ups more effectively and automatically direct incoming leads to the right team member. Sales Hub Starter also introduces early-stage automation and process control features that help small teams sell more efficiently without the complexity or cost of higher tiers.

Starter supports fast-growing teams ready for professional-grade tools without enterprise complexity.

- HubSpot branding removed from chat and meetings
- Multiple currencies accepted for payment
- HubSpot Payments and Stripe payment integration (U.S. only)
- Unlimited email open and click notifications, plus custom tracking domains.
- Up to 5,000 canned snippets and documents that can easily be shared with prospects
- Meeting scheduling and conversation routing

#### Trade-offs vs. Free Tools

- Advantage: Branding control, automation, routing
- Cost: $108-180/annually per user vs. $0
- Limitation: Still limited in automation, email health reporting, conversational bots, and goal setting.

Best for: Small sales teams looking to standardize processes, track deals more efficiently, and route conversations without committing to complex infrastructure.
